licensing: Editorial EU website contentCC BY4.0. Statistical data/metadata reuse authorised with source acknowledgement under European Commission reuse policy and item-specific exceptions. Non-EU/EFTA/candidate-country data (includingUSA/India) not covered for commercial reuse; trade/third-party/logo exceptions apply. Current query plan limits itself to EU countries/aggregate.
limitations: No USA/India civic-cell coverage claimed. Eurostat-population attribution in World Bank remains unresolved.
Dataset updated twice daily when changed; provider says no historical dataset-version archive. Structure version is not immutable data edition.
Only exact numeric observations, not semantic article/book search, microdata, map geometry or personal records.
next_action: Complete native reader/accessibility, dataset-definition remainder and revision/later-day reliability. Do not treat shared connectors or country cells as origins; geographic commercial-reuse exceptions remain explicit.

identity_and_duplicates.summary: One Eurostat catalog; datasets, country cells, languages and API versions are not independent origins.

coverage_and_languages.summary: Ten actual English2022 population-density cells cover theEU27 aggregate and nine EU member states; noUSA/India civic closure, alternate-language or whole-Eurostat coverage claim.

query_contract.summary: Ten distinct exact JSON-stat population-density cell requests pass; one prior documented-example capture is reused with its original timestamp/hash. A2021 partition is distinct from2022;2200 returns a valid empty cube and cannot count as a positive record.

unsupported: pagination parameters; partition by documented dimensions/time instead

rights_and_cost.summary: Current official policy separates editorialCC BY4.0 from statistical-data reuse and geographic/third-party exceptions.
